name: Hypertree Grid Object
aliases: Hypertree Grid Object — GE, Hypertree Grid
definition: A Hypertree Grid object in dimension d ∈ {1, 2, 3} with branching factor f ∈ N* and extent E ∈ N*^d × {1}^(3-d), denoted G_E^{d,f}, is a data set comprising Π_E hypertree objects in dimension d and with branching factor f, denoted H_{i,j,k} where (i, j, k) ∈ J_E^J.
summary: The Hypertree Grid Object efficiently stores sparse AMR data with rectilinear geometry, reducing memory by an order of magnitude while enabling optimized traversal and virtual pruning.
